buffs: HolloVVeen Event Charm (Grave Wars / HolloVVeen Chests)
Upon receiving fatal damage, enter a brief invulnerability window to retaliate before falling

charms.title: Witches Brew
charms.desc: A volatile concoction bubbling with eerie unpredictability.
buffs: HolloVVeen Event Charm (Grave Wars / HolloVVeen Chests)
Casting skills periodically triggers erratic potion surges, applying random status effects or temporary stat surges

charms.title: Jack-o-Lantern
charms.desc: Carved with a demonic grin and burning spectral fire.
buffs: HolloVVeen Event Charm (Grave Wars / HolloVVeen Chests)
Attacks ignite targets in spectral hollow fire, causing damage over time and revealing cloaked targets

charms.title: Dracula’s Fangs
charms.desc: Insatiable thirst for the life essence of your prey.
buffs: HolloVVeen Event Charm (Dracula Pack / Grave Wars)
Grants significant life steal on critical and heavy attacks against bleeding or maimed targets

traits.name: Tentacles
passives: 16% chance to inflict poison damage on melee attacks

traits.name: Iron Skin
traits.notable: You gain thick iron like skin, similar to an arrancar's Hierro.

traits.name: Energized
traits.notable: Explosive power bubbles beneath your skin.
passives: Weapon damage slightly scales off your kido stat.

essences.name: Haste
essences.desc: Decreases skill cooldowns. Slightly increases passive reiatsu regen.

essences.name: Potency
essences.desc: Increases stat scaling. Slightly increases melee posture damage.

essences.name: Shunpo
essences.desc: Increases shunpo stamina and shunpo speed.

essences.name: Flowing Gradient
essences.desc: Strength skill essence unlocked via Battle for Dangai vote. Amplifies fluid momentum on heavy strikes.

essences.name: Slaying Drive
essences.desc: Speed skill essence introduced in v5.2. Boosts chase velocity, rapid engagement, and relentless combo tempo.

attributes.name: Speed
attributes.desc: Affects shunpo speed and weakly affects shunpo stamina.

codes.reward: Clan Reroll Tickets (Redeem at Fort Adams)

statInvestmentMilestones.scaling: Every 10 Build Points invested increases all other build points and stats by +1 (tested up to 50 BP).

passives.effect: Unlocks second tier ultimate essence passive.
Unlocks major specialization passive shifting away from hybrid meta.

statInvestmentMilestones.resetPolicy: Free Build Reset available once per account (level ceiling removed).

combatSystems.name: Traversing
combatSystems.desc: Hold Q out of combat to rapidly traverse via flashstep / sonido / hirenkyaku at reduced resource cost.

combatSystems.name: Anti-Gank
combatSystems.desc: Taking damage from non-allied enemies builds Anti-Gank stacks granting damage reduction, posture regen, and boosted aura heal.

combatSystems.name: Combo Falloff
combatSystems.desc: Sustained true combos trigger severe damage falloff until the victim is released from stun.

combatSystems.name: Transmutation
combatSystems.desc: Detransmutating accessories now safely refunds the transmutated accessory.
